title: A long passing `cargo test --bin termal` run is refused credit as "output shows no passing test" when its output is large
outcome: A recognised test command that passes is credited, or refused for a stated cause, whatever the size of its output. The host does not read "no passing test" off a truncated window of a large output.
acceptance: A long passing `cargo test --bin termal` run is refused credit as "output shows no passing test" when its output is large is done
